newsitem.title: USA: Alamance County, N.C., plans $25 million bond vote.
newsitem.headline: Alamance County, N.C., plans $25 million bond vote.

text.p: North Carolina's Alamance County Commission gave preliminary approval for a November referendum on a $25 million school bond proposal, the Greensboro News & Record said Tuesday.

Commissioners approved the referendum 4-1 Monday night. But the referendum may have to be postponed until May if the county misses a July 21 deadline for drafting a detailed plan specifying how the money would be spent.

A capital needs report for the newly merged Alamance-Burlington School District is due June 30, but will not list projects in order of priority, so the county may be unable to make the deadline, the newspaper said.
